strings: Not much could be done with the frequent itching and jabbing m_c felt to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes from a stray hair or debri, but r_c0 still feels guilty seeing how m_c's eyes have started to get cloudier.

The itching or jabbing from a pesky hair or occasional debri was annoying, sure, but m_c feels far more alarmed now that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} noticed a cloudiness to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} vision.
